h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nellore

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nellore

items.pText: Slides are the first thing most children run to, and the first thing most buyers in Nellore ask us about. Which height, which shape and where should it face? The answer depends on the age of the children, the space you have and the sun, which on this hot stretch of the Andhra coast is strong for most of the year.

FunPlay Systems makes slides, swings, climbers and complete play systems at our factory in Vasai, about 930 km from Nellore. We send the equipment by road and our installation team or a dealer in the region installs it. Schools, housing layouts and parks along the Penna make up most of our work in this area. Share the site size, the age group and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Our individual slides come in three heights. A
suits toddlers and nursery classes. A
suits most primary children and comes in curve, wave, spiral and tunnel shapes. The tallest range is for older children on bigger grounds, and it needs a longer clear run-out at the bottom.

In Nellore, face open slides away from the afternoon sun, or choose a tunnel slide, which keeps the sliding surface covered. Leave enough flat space at the exit so a child can stand and move away before the next one arrives.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 930 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which slide is best for a primary school in Nellore?
items.a: A 5 ft slide suits most primary children. If the ground is in full sun, a tunnel or spiral tunnel slide keeps the surface shaded. We can suggest a shape once we see your site.

items.q: How much space does a slide need?
items.a: Each slide needs a clear safe play area around it, with extra space at the exit. The taller the slide, the longer that space. We mark it on the layout drawing.

items.q: Do you deliver to Nellore and nearby towns?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Nellore, Kavali, Ongole and other towns in the region, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.
